captions.caption: A lively, uplifting pop track featuring a male vocalist who sings parts of the song in his head voice, accompanied by an intro of piano and occasional appearances by a female vocalist, all supported by a driving, energetic beat that makes it perfect for getting your energy up and lifting your mood, whether you're dancing along or just enjoying the catchy, upbeat vibe.
An uplifting pop song, performed by a male and a female voice with EDM arrangements.
